main.description: A single media asset stored on the creator's OWN PDS as a blob. For PUBLIC posts the blob is cleartext bytes; for gated (subscriber/tier) posts the blob is ciphertext and `encryption` describes how an entitled subscriber decrypts it. foryour.fans-owned object storage is NEVER the durable home for this — see docs/creator-owned-pds.md and prompts/creator-owned-pds.md.

blob.description: The media bytes on the creator's PDS. Cleartext for public media; AES-256-GCM ciphertext when `encryption` is present.

mimeType.description: The plaintext media MIME type (e.g. image/jpeg). May differ from the blob's own mimeType when the blob holds ciphertext.

duration.description: Duration in whole seconds, for audio/video.

labels.description: Self-label content warnings, using the core protocol's self-label mechanism.

encryption.description: Present ONLY for gated media. Absence means the blob is public cleartext.

encryptionMetadata.description: How to decrypt a gated media blob. Contains NO key material — only a reference a compatible service resolves to a per-media content key via its own entitlement/key-grant flow.

keyRef.description: Opaque identifier a key-grant endpoint maps to the per-media content key. Conventionally the media record's own AT URI. Never the key itself.

tag.description: Base64-encoded AEAD authentication tag, when not appended to the ciphertext.
